EXAM TRAP   The filter decides the answer
Two analysts querying the same table can report different totals if one keeps cancelled orders and the other does not. When a figure is disputed, the first question is what the query filtered out, not whether the data is wrong.

WORKED EXAMPLE   The pattern behind the example
Start from the decision, not from the data.
Look at the data before modelling it, and say how much of it there is.
Treat what the first look suggests as a hypothesis, never as a finding.
The model exists to test the hypothesis, and may qualify it rather than confirm it.

EXAM TRAP   Exam view
A question describes an analyst at some point in the work and asks what should happen next. Follow the cycle: understand, prepare, model, evaluate, deploy. If the evaluation has not been done, the answer is not yet a finding.
